questions.question: Doctor : Hospital :: Teacher : ?
questions.explanation: A doctor works in a hospital. In the same way, a teacher works in a school.

questions.question: Bird : Nest :: Bee : ?
questions.explanation: A bird lives in a nest, and a bee lives in a hive.

questions.question: Pen : Write :: Knife : ?
questions.explanation: A pen is used to write. A knife is used to cut.

questions.question: Head : Cap :: Foot : ?
questions.explanation: A cap is worn on the head. A shoe is worn on the foot.

questions.question: Day : Night :: Hot : ?
questions.explanation: Day and night are opposites. The opposite of hot is cold.

questions.question: Cow : Calf :: Dog : ?
questions.explanation: A calf is the young one of a cow. A puppy is the young one of a dog.

questions.question: Cobbler : Shoes :: Carpenter : ?
questions.explanation: A cobbler makes or repairs shoes. A carpenter makes furniture.

questions.question: Thermometer : Temperature :: Barometer : ?
questions.explanation: A thermometer measures temperature. A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: Lion : Den :: Horse : ?
questions.explanation: A lion lives in a den. A horse is kept in a stable.

questions.question: Ear : Hear :: Eye : ?
questions.explanation: The ear is used to hear. The eye is used to see.

questions.question: CAT : DBU :: DOG : ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves one step forward: C→D, A→B, T→U. So D→E, O→P, G→H, giving EPH.

questions.question: Book : Library :: Painting : ?
questions.explanation: Books are kept in a library. Paintings are displayed in a gallery.

questions.question: ACE : FHJ :: LNP : ?
questions.explanation: Each letter moves forward by 5: A→F, C→H, E→J. So L→Q, N→S, P→U, giving QSU.

questions.question: Chapter : Book :: Verse : ?
questions.explanation: A chapter is a part of a book. A verse is a part of a poem.

questions.question: Metre : Length :: Kilogram : ?
questions.explanation: The metre is a unit of length, and the kilogram is a unit of mass.

questions.question: Seed : Plant :: Egg : ?
questions.explanation: A seed grows into a plant. An egg hatches into a bird.
